name: Bully sticks
h1: Bully sticks: ingredients, origin claims and sizes by brand
title: Bully sticks compared: ingredients, made-in claims & sizes | Nibbables
meta: Bully sticks from Campfire Treats, GREAT DOG, Best Bully Sticks, Redbarn, Jack&Pup, Mighty Paw, Raw Paws and more, with each brand's ingredient list, made-in and sourcing claims, and sizes, quoted from their own pages.
intro: The bully sticks listed here are all described by their brands as beef (or bison) pizzle. Each card quotes the brand's own product page for ingredients, where it says the product is made and sourced, what size of dog it says the stick is for, and its supervision note.

name: Yak cheese chews
h1: Yak (Himalayan) cheese chews: ingredients and origin by brand
title: Yak cheese chews compared: ingredients & origin claims | Nibbables
meta: Himalayan yak cheese dog chews from Mighty Paw, Pupford, Pawstruck, Raw Paws and Best Bully Sticks, with ingredients and origin claims quoted from each brand's page.
intro: Yak cheese chews are hard cheese chews that the brands describe as made from yak and/or cow milk, salt and lime juice. Ingredient lists differ: some brands list yak milk only, others yak and cow milk. Each card quotes the brand's own page.

name: Beef cheek rolls
h1: Beef cheek rolls: ingredients and origin by brand
title: Beef cheek rolls compared: ingredients & country of origin | Nibbables
meta: Beef cheek roll dog chews from Redbarn, Raw Paws and Best Bully Sticks, with ingredients and country-of-origin claims quoted from each brand's page.
intro: Beef cheek rolls are rolled chews made from beef cheek. Some are single-ingredient, and some (like chicken-wrapped versions) list several ingredients, including preservatives. Each card quotes the brand's own ingredient list.

name: Rawhide-free chews
h1: Rawhide-free chews: products whose brand states "rawhide-free"
title: Rawhide-free dog chews: brands that state it, quoted | Nibbables
meta: Dog chews whose brand explicitly states they are rawhide-free or made without rawhide, including Earth Animal No-Hide, with the exact wording quoted from each brand's page.
intro: This page lists products whose brand page explicitly says they are rawhide-free or made without rawhide, quoting that wording. It includes Earth Animal's No-Hide rolls (a baked chew with several ingredients) and any other product in the directory whose page states it. A product that isn't listed here may still contain no rawhide. Its page just doesn't say so in those words.

name: Antlers
h1: Elk and deer antler chews: sourcing claims by brand
title: Elk & deer antler dog chews compared: sourcing claims & sizes | Nibbables
meta: Elk and deer antler dog chews from GREAT DOG, Redbarn, Mighty Paw, Nature Gnaws and Best Bully Sticks, with sourcing claims, size guidance and supervision notes quoted from each brand.
intro: Antler chews are made from elk or deer antler. Most brands here describe their antlers as naturally shed, and several describe them as durable chews for strong chewers. Check each brand's size guidance, and ask your vet whether a hard chew suits your dog's teeth.

meta: Beef collagen dog chews from Raw Paws Pet Food, Best Bully Sticks and Jack&Pup, with each brand's ingredient list, origin claims and sizes quoted from their own pages.
intro: Collagen sticks are chews brands describe as made from beef collagen or bovine hide (a source of collagen). Ingredient lists and origin claims differ by brand. Each card quotes the brand's own product page.
